title: Helion Energy floating header
description: A barless floating header: on desktop a centred group of the brand mark, a 40px navy pill of uppercase mono links and a white Careers pill beside it; on phones the mark left and a white 34px menu square right that opens a navy panel of links. The mark fades out over the first 300px of scrolling; links dim to 60% on hover (0.2s ease-out).
notes: position="fixed" (default) floats over the page with no background of its own; use "static" in previews
the mark is light (secondary-foreground) to sit on a dark hero; it fades away with a CSS scroll timeline
the phone menu is a <details> element: no JavaScript
name: helionenergy-header
